end.summary:
Dev gave examples of Bishnoi, sacred groves and the Chipko movement, including ways they protect nature.
Dev partly practised explaining effects on soil, plants and animals; this was not steady yet and needs checking next time.
Dev is still building the connection between traditional knowledge and scientific explanations.
Dev repeatedly said that only the government or adults can protect nature; this was not corrected by the last turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised examples of Bishnoi, sacred groves and Chipko with Dev, then asked how these practices protect plants, animals, water and soil. Dev could name the examples and suggested actions such as keeping water for birds and planting saplings, but the mix-up that only adults or the government can make a difference remained at the end. At home, ask Dev to choose one traditional practice and explain its effect using “because,” such as “A sacred grove protects soil because…”.
